text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 272 units at 9.8 per day (28 days on hand), Corvale Lakeside holds 15 units at 1.7 per day (9 days on hand), and Corvale East holds 182 units at 7.3 per day (25 days on hand). The NDC 64380076721 used at all three sites is labeled by Strides Pharma Science Limited (FEI 3004554612).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1319788 of the Strides facility ended on 2026-05-20 and received a VAI classification, with the classification known to FDA on 2026-08-14. A separate FDA shortage listing for the same generic combination under Salix Pharmaceuticals shows a status of To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-08-13 and notes a business decision to discontinue manufacture. The links between the Strides-supplied NDC and the Salix discontinuation are weak.

Our position: The root cause for this specific NDC's shortage should be verified with the supplier and FDA. Corvale Lakeside has the lowest days on hand and requires immediate support.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 9 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — Corvale General retains two weeks supply; Corvale Lakeside reaches 14 days. Needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
2. Transfer 9 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — Corvale East retains two weeks supply; Corvale Lakeside reaches 14 days. Needs pharmacy director approval for transfer request.
3. Buy from A-S Medication Solutions — Not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Needs buyer approval.
4. Buy from Affordable Pharmaceuticals, LLC — Not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Needs buyer approval.
5. Buy from Aurobindo Pharma Limited — Not on FDA shortage list today; label names no plant we could place. Needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
